title: FINALIST STRESS, ABLATION & CONCENTRATION
hypothesis: The two frozen viable tree finalists retain economically meaningful predictive and portfolio behavior under controlled perturbations, concentration removal, execution stress and dependence-aware uncertainty analysis.

feature_noise.application: prediction-time only; deterministic Gaussian perturbation per feature scaled by training standard deviation

rank_perturbation.application: prediction score plus deterministic Gaussian noise within signal-date scaled by cross-sectional score standard deviation

regimes.VOL_HIGH: BIST100 trailing 63-session realized vol above full pre-locked signal-date median

concentration.pnl_method: prior-day portfolio weight times close-to-close research return

classification.ROBUST_WITH_CAVEATS: at least six dimensions pass, cost/delay survive, and bootstrap P(IC>0) and P(net>0) are each >=0.50
classification.FRAGILE: at least one primary economic channel survives but fewer than six dimensions pass
classification.REJECTED: 100bps cost or +2 delay mean net return <=0, or both bootstrap probabilities <0.50

dimension_rules.feature: at least two of three ablations mean IC >=0
dimension_rules.seed_parameter: seed IC std <=0.05 and both parameter variants mean IC >=0
